# Touchstone Martial Arts

## Site
https://sacramentokungfu.com/

## Summary
Touchstone Martial Arts is a Sacramento-area Wing Chun Kung Fu school. The school teaches Wing Chun with emphasis on close-range self-defense, efficient movement, touch sensitivity, Jeet Fa fundamentals, lineage education, and apprenticeship-style teaching.

## Primary topics
- Sacramento Wing Chun Kung Fu
- Sacramento Kung Fu classes
- Wing Chun self-defense
- Jeet Fa training
- Yip Man / Ip Man Wing Chun tradition
- Pan Nam Wing Chun tradition
- Touchstone Martial Arts
- Sifu Michael Nedderman
